question.problem:
Fred picked $10$ watermelons from his vegetable garden. The weight of watermelons he grows is normally distributed with a mean of $11\,\text{kg}$ and a standard deviation of $3\,\text{kg}.$ What is the probability that the total weight of the watermelons Fred picked is greater than $100\,\text{kg}$ and less than $110\,\text{kg}?$ You may assume that the weights of the watermelons are mutually independent.

*Hint: A table of values of $Φ(z)$ for different values of $z$ is given below, where $Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution.*

| $z$ | $\,0.02\,$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.04\,$ | $\,0.05\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,1.0\,$ | $\,0.8461\,$ | $\,0.8485\,$ | $\,0.8508\,$ | $\,0.8531\,$ |
| $\,1.1\,$ | $\,0.8686\,$ | $\,0.8708\,$ | $\,0.8729\,$ | $\,0.8749\,$ |
| $\,1.2\,$ | $\,0.8888\,$ | $\,0.8907\,$ | $\,0.8925\,$ | $\,0.8944\,$ |
